newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian All Ordinaries seen overbought.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian All Ordinaries seen overbought.

text.p: -------------Australian All Ordinaries Index----------------
---------------Analysis by Daniel Fock - May 5--------------
*Rally over-extended
*Expect some consolidation/retracement
*Index overbought
*All Ordinaries index closed at 2,491.6 on Friday
The Australian All Ordinaries Index is still bullish, but ended the week off recent highs.
Traders are likely to remain long, but tighten protective trailing stops. The 2,500 psychological barrier will need to be broken again before fresh buying enters the market.
Short term technicals are bullish, and overbought. Averages are bullish, Leading indicators again higher, and overbought.
The ROC is the only leading indicator that is off its peak.
Traders will be focusing on the Fibonacci retracements of the nearly 200 point move back to 2,448, 2,428 and 2,407.
In the medium term, the index is again higher making a new high at 2,515. 2,460 is important and while the index is above this traders are likely to remain long.
Traders however will be raising stops, to protect profits.
Medium term technicals are bullish. The averages are bullish.
Leading indicators have been choppy, but now are showing sustained gains.
The index is not yet overbought, but it is only a matter of time. The Bollinger Bands are, however, showing that the rally is over extended so some profits takers could be tempted to liquidate longs.
In the longer term, the index is still bullish, with longer term support still some way off at 2,350 and 2,290.
Last month was an outside range month, so traders are likely to be watching the highs and lows for directional confirmation.
Currently close to last month's high, traders will remain bullish.
Longer term technicals are bullish and overbought.
The averages remain bullish, but all the leading indicators are higher and overbought.
Traders are most likely still cautiously bullish, and keen to bank some profits. Fibonacci retracements of the bull move to 2,515 are 2,248, 2,166 and 2,083.
The index rallied to a new high on Wednesday and is overbought. Traders will remain cautiously bullish, and tighten trailing stops.
Watch for profit takers, and expect some consolidation/retracement since the index is well overdue for a break.
So if the market rallies again, or shows signs of short term weakness, expect some temptation to lighten long positions.
The bulls are still in control, but traders are likely to be focusing on the Fibonacci levels as possible retracements, and tightening trails stops as the index is very overbought.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysts Association. Views are his own, not those of Reuters.)
